text.p: Monsanto Co said Monday it completed details of a non-exclusive technology collaboration with Empresas La Moderna SA de CV.

Under the agreement, Monsanto will be a preferred supplier of agronomic and quality traits developed through biotechnology for use in Empresas La Moderna's fruit and vegetable seed and produce businesses.

"Monsanto's research in both agronomic and quality traits can be rapidly expanded into fruits and vegetables through (Empresas La Moderna's) leadership position in these markets," Hendrik Verfaillie, Monsanto executive vice president, said in a statement.
Earlier, Monsanto completed the acquisition of Asgrow Agronomics business of Seminis Inc, an Empresas La Moderna subsidiary, for $240 million.
Asgrow is a major U.S. soybean seed company based in Kalamazoo, Mich.

About 45 percent of Asgrow's sales are in soybeans, approximately 40 percent in corn and the remainder in a variety of other crops. More than 70 percent of its sales are in the Americas and more than 25 percent are in Europe.
